messages:
maria: Quick question for SOC2 pack — external auditor asked for proof that a temporary RBAC binding we created during the model migration had proper approvals and that the KMS key usage there is within rotation policy. They also want to know how vuln triage from that migration got linked to the incident timeline.

ryan: Which binding are they referring to? the one we added to the 'inference-mig' SA last week?

maria: Yes — the serviceAccount binding that granted cluster-admin for a ~2h window (rollback completed). They want: who requested, approval artifact, terraform diff, KMS decrypt logs for the CMK used, and the vulnerability ticket linkage.

priya: I have the terraform PR and the github approval thread. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 — approvers: jenkins-bot + eng-lead. Approvals are in the PR history.

sam: For KMS logs we can pull the CloudKMS audit entries. Example splunk query I used: 
```
index=cloudkms sourcetype="gcp:cloudkms" resource.labels.key_ring="projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/serve-keys" action="cryptoKeyVersions/cryptoKeyVersion:asymmetricDecrypt" OR action="Decrypt" | stats count by protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail,protoPayload.methodName, timestamp
```
That will show which principal invoked decrypt and when.

maria: Perfect. Auditor also asked for "proof of least privilege" rationale for the temporary admin. We documented migration runbook but didn’t attach a signed exception form. Is that an automatic fail?

compliance-bot: Note: For SOC2 evidence, exceptions must have documented risk acceptance and owner. If missing, tag as "finding" but can be mitigated with retroactive sign-off within 5 business days.

ryan: We do have an incident ticket (INC-2026) where the migration steps and justification were posted by @maria. It includes the rollback timeline and post-mig checklist. Should we link that as part of the proof?

maria: Yes — include INC-2026 and the terraform PR. Also include the audit log export (sam's splunk query) and the KMS key metadata (key rotation timestamps).

jen: For linking vuln triage: the vulnerability that popped during migration was CVE-2024-9876 in our 3rd party lib. The vuln triage ticket is VULN-391 and has mitigation steps. The auditor wants to see the mapping: migration -> vuln detection -> mitigation -> verification. I can export the JIRA changelog.

priya: Can we also show the deployment commit hash and the k8s rollout history? auditors like to see the exact binary/commit that was present when the access change happened.

sam: kubectl snippet to capture rollout history and pod evts: 
```
kubectl -n inference rollout history deployment/serve-api --revision=5
kubectl -n inference get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=serve-api --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -n 50
```
Save those outputs as plaintext.

maria: Good. Action list for packaging the evidence bundle:
- priya: export PR approval screenshots + github audit log (sha + approver emails)
- sam: splunk query export of KMS decrypt events for the CMK (time window: migration window +/- 1h)
- jen: JIRA export linking VULN-391 -> INC-2026 and verdict notes
- ryan: terraform plan/diff + applied state snapshot (terraform state show)
- maria: compose an executive summary with timeline + sign-off doc request to eng-lead

ryan: Quick Q: for the KMS decrypt logs, do we need to redact any PII (service account full email) before handing to the auditor?

compliance-bot: Guidance: Auditors can receive emails in evidence packages; redact only if the data contains personal employee identifiers beyond corporate emails. Corporate service account emails (e.g., svc-migrate@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com) are OK.

priya: One more edge-case: the CMK was rotated in the same week as migration (auto rotation scheduled). Auditor asked whether rotation could have invalidated any previous encryptions referenced in backup manifests. I checked — rotation was AddNewKeyVersion (no rewrap), backups are intact. I'll include keyVersion IDs.

maria: If rotation created potential gaps we should also include our backup verification run output. But since it's re-encrypt-unnecessary, include the keyVersion list and explain.

jen: I'll attach the vuln triage verification (post-fix scans) and the regression test run IDs. That should close the loop.

sam: I'll export the splunk search as CSV and include the query text and search SID for reproducibility.

maria: Great. Last ask from auditor: proof that temporary binding was revoked automatically by infra code (we had a TTL). Can we show the controller's reconciliation event?

ryan: Yes — the controller wrote a revert event in controller logs. Sample log snippet:
```
2024-06-14T14:12:07Z controller inference-operator INFO Reverting temporary-binding inference-mig svcAccount=svc-migrate reason=completed user=eng-lead commit=abc123
```
I will grab the full log lines and timestamp ranges.

maria: Ok team — target to package and upload to the auditor share by EOD tomorrow. I'll create a ZIP and post the manifest here when ready. If anyone hits a blocker ping me.

priya: on it, I'll attach PR export shortly.

sam: kicking off splunk export now.

jen: exporting JIRA crosswalk.

maria: thanks — closing the loop here once uploads are in. :white_check_mark:
